scripts.//build:core: Unlike @taprootcms/studio, which ships source and is compiled by the host's Vite pipeline, @taprootcms/core is consumed as compiled `dist/` — its exports map points there, and the seed/migrate scripts import it under plain node. Nothing but `npm install` (via prepare) and `npm run build` ever ran tsc, so editing core and running dev served the *previous* compile: the missing symbol surfaces as `@taprootcms/core does not provide an export named X`, which reads like the export was never written rather than never rebuilt. Hence the pre-hooks below on every entry point that loads core. Incremental `tsc --build` is ~0.2s when up to date.
scripts.dev: npm run dev:studio && npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@taprootcms/core && npm run build --workspace=@taprootcms/studio-app && npm run build --workspace=@taprootcms/web
scripts.//typecheck: Per-workspace rather than a root `tsc --build`: there is no root tsconfig, and the Astro-facing projects cannot be tsc project references — their sources are .astro, which tsc has no resolver for. The two apps are type-checked by `npm run build`.
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@taprootcms/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@taprootcms/studio && npm run typecheck --workspace=@taprootcms/astro
scripts.//taproot:types: Generates apps/web/src/content.d.ts from the live content model, read over the delivery API rather than out of the database — so the types describe what a consumer actually receives. Needs a running server; set TAPROOT_API_URL and TAPROOT_API_KEY for anything but local dev.
scripts.//docs: The handbook. A separate Astro app with no database and no admin, so it builds and deploys on its own — and so the demo site stays a demo rather than doubling as the product's documentation. Port 4322 keeps it clear of `npm run dev`.
scripts.//dev: Two servers now. `dev` starts both — the studio on :4321 (admin + delivery API) and the reference consumer on :4323. Astro 7 daemonises each, so they survive the command returning; `astro dev stop --root apps/studio` and `--root apps/web` stop them. Docs sit on :4322.
